articles.headline: Historic Xi-Trump-Putin Summit Set for Shenzhen
articles.brief: China has officially confirmed that a historic trilateral summit involving leaders Xi Jinping, Donald Trump, and Vladimir Putin will take place in Shenzhen, marking a major diplomatic development on the global stage.

articles.headline: US and Russia Oppose Autonomous Weapons Limits
articles.brief: The United States and Russia have announced their joint opposition to upcoming international talks aimed at limiting the development and deployment of lethal autonomous weapons systems.

articles.headline: Yemeni Forces Retreat in Major Houthi Setback
articles.brief: Yemeni government forces have suffered a significant operational setback, retreating from a vital strategic strait amid escalating regional conflicts involving anti-Houthi positions and recent strikes.

articles.headline: India Joins US-Led AI Supply Chain Pact
articles.brief: India has officially joined the US-led San Francisco Declaration, an international pact aimed at safeguarding critical artificial intelligence and semiconductor supply chains from external vulnerabilities and geopolitical competition.

articles.headline: Boeing-Lockheed Rocket Fails, Destroying Satellites
articles.brief: A rocket manufactured by the Boeing-Lockheed joint venture suffered a mid-flight failure, completely destroying its payload of commercial Amazon broadband satellites in a severe blow to the aerospace initiative.

articles.headline: Oil Prices Slide on Supply Surplus Forecasts
articles.brief: Crude oil prices experienced a downward trend as global markets digested incoming forecasts predicting a notable supply surplus in the near-term future, pressuring major energy producers.

articles.headline: Gold Holds Steady as Rate Cut Signals Awaited
articles.brief: Gold prices remained stable in early trading sessions as global investors held back major moves, awaiting upcoming economic remarks for definitive signals regarding future interest rate adjustments.

articles.headline: India's Solar Manufacturing Capacity Hits 116 GW
articles.brief: India's domestic solar manufacturing sector has reached a milestone of 116 gigawatts, propelled by strong governmental backing through the Production-Linked Incentive scheme aimed at boosting domestic output.

articles.headline: Canada May Turn to Chinese Autos If US Talks Fail
articles.brief: Canadian trade representatives suggested that the nation could explore commercial partnerships with Chinese automakers if ongoing trade negotiations with the United States collapse, contingent on local manufacturing.

articles.headline: Delhi AQI Reaches Hazardous Level of 800
articles.brief: Air quality in India's capital plummeted to hazardous levels with the live Air Quality Index touching 800, placing Delhi among the most polluted urban centers globally and prompting urgent health concerns.

articles.headline: Mirra Andreeva Wins WTA Finals and Claims No. 2 Spot
articles.brief: Mirra Andreeva secured a stellar victory over Elina Svitolina in the WTA Finals championship match, a triumph that elevates her career-ranking to world number two in women's tennis.

articles.headline: England Level ODI Series Against Australia in Adelaide
articles.brief: England delivered a commanding batting performance at the Adelaide Oval, defeating Australia by 135 runs to successfully level the current bilateral ODI series 1-1.

articles.headline: IMD Issues Cyclone Alert for Andhra and Odisha
articles.brief: The India Meteorological Department has issued high alerts for coastal Andhra Pradesh and Odisha as a deep depression over the Bay of Bengal rapidly intensifies toward a severe cyclonic storm.

articles.headline: Vande Bharat Train Runs 463 km Without Proper Brakes
articles.brief: Railway authorities initiated an inquiry after a Vande Bharat express train reportedly operated for over 463 kilometers despite reported braking deficiencies highlighted by operating loco pilots.
